definitions.explanation: A person who designs the physical appearance of a book — its cover, binding, paper, and overall layout. A specialized creative profession in publishing.

examples.japanese: {有名|ゆうめい}な{装丁家|そうていか}が{表紙|ひょうし}を{手|て}がけた。
examples.english: A famous book designer worked on the cover.

examples.japanese: この{本|ほん}の{美|うつく}しさは{装丁家|そうていか}の{力|ちから}によるものだ。
examples.english: The beauty of this book is thanks to the book designer.

examples.japanese: {装丁家|そうていか}は、{紙|かみ}の{質感|しつかん}や{文字|もじ}の{配置|はいち}まで{細|こま}かく{考|かんが}える。
examples.english: A book designer thinks carefully about everything down to the texture of the paper and the placement of the type.

notes:
Formed from {装丁|そうてい} (book design, binding) + {家|か} (specialist; -ist). Refers to a professional who designs books.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {装丁家|そうていか}が{手|て}がける: a book designer works on (a book)
- {人気|にんき}の{装丁家|そうていか}: a popular book designer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {装丁|そうてい}: book design; binding — the work itself, not the person.
- デザイナー: designer — the general loanword, not specific to books.
